hook: Your boat in Manipur floats among drifting islands.
title: India's Lake With a Floating National Park
description:
Loktak Lake in Manipur is covered in phumdis, floating mats of vegetation and soil. On them sits Keibul Lamjao, the world's only floating national park.

Series: Places That Shouldn't Exist.
comment_prompt: Would you visit? Yes or no
